pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding positions within 15 minutes of a previous loss or during expanding volatility wicks; scale-ins only allowed after a confirmed 2R continuation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block and volume-weighted average price (VWAP) convergence check before entry; no execution allowed during high-impact spread-expansion intervals.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stops or scale-out partial profits aggressively once floating profit hits +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric win-to-loss ratios.
